name: AI-Food-App
description: AI food assistant: chat for recipes, save them, build shopping lists and plan meals. React, FastAPI, MongoDB, Groq.

paragraphs: A full-stack web app that helps you decide what to cook. Chat with an AI assistant that understands your dietary needs, finds recipes and cooking videos from across the web, and lets you save recipes, build shopping lists and plan your meals.
Stack: React 19 · TypeScript · Redux Toolkit · Tailwind CSS · FastAPI · MongoDB · Firebase Auth · Groq (Llama 4)
features: Conversational recipe assistant. Ask for "a high-protein vegetarian dinner" and the LLM decides when to call a recipe-search tool, passing along filters such as cuisine, meal type, diet and health restrictions.
Web-sourced recipes and videos. Results come from Google Custom Search, with the pages scraped and cleaned by the backend, plus YouTube video lookups.
Multiple conversations. Create, rename, delete and revisit chats. Edit earlier messages.
Saved recipes. Save any recipe from a chat, edit it in a built-in editor, and browse your collection.
Shopping lists. Generated alongside recipes and kept per user.

whatItDoes.text: A full-stack web app that helps you decide what to cook. Chat with an AI assistant that understands your dietary needs, finds recipes and cooking videos from across the web, and lets you save recipes, build shopping lists and plan your meals.

requirements.text: Email and password sign-up with email verification, Google sign-in via Firebase, JWT access and refresh tokens.
A Firebase project with Google and Email/Password sign-in enabled
